summary: Converted every fixed TCP bind in the cli src/test trees to ephemeral allocation: 7 in-process servers now listen on port 0 behind an ephemeralPort guard, and 2 child-process servers reserve a port via probe socket. Deleted the three PORT_PLAN constants behind the EADDRINUSE 44210 collision; replaced the cohort test's exact-port assertions with stronger source-level checks forbidding any hardcoded loopback port. Set global testTimeout/hookTimeout 120_000 in vite.config.ts (chosen because 3 contended failures were unidentified and packages/trust tests are outside contract) and raised in-contract 30_000 timeouts to 300_000. tsc, lint, and two consecutive full runs all green: 878/878, 144s and 150s.
open_questions: react-boilerplate-v4-data-flow-run.ts:417 still binds fixed port 43440: its origin is recorded in sealed evidence/runs/react-boilerplate-v4-data-flow/artifacts/upgrade.json, so making it ephemeral would break that artifact's digest and the CLI determinism verify. No test exercises it, so the gate is unaffected. Should a later unit re-publish that evidence to close the last fixed port?
